info.name: Time Tracker API
info.description: Postman collection generated from API Documentation

formdata.description: timezone (Phase 6): a real IANA identifier, e.g. America/New_York — mainly meaningful for COMPANY accounts (used by the daily overtime sweep)

query.description: required for every role except employee

request.description: COMPANY: always their own company, `company` in the body is ignored. ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN: `company` given scopes to one company (404 if it doesn't exist); omitted means every company (cross-company).
